status_menu.doc: The status page (M2-MNU-03; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Items and Status pages). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3. 'list' (the heroes) is a MenuPage metrics block, as tall as its rows; its rank column says Fallen. Under it on the left, each section_gap under the one above (their rects give x and width; y follows the list): 'swell' (the gauge and the fill mode) and 'carried' (statuses a fight starts with, then what each does in up to desc_lines lines). 'portrait' (centre, top; M2-MNU-301): the hero's portrait (HeroPortraitFrame), with 'vitals' right of it: the hero's name and level (and under them, note_lift into the name row, note_height tall and shrunk to note_min_scale at the least, a story note such as Kerrid's after his reveal), then HP and MP with their gauges. 'stats' (centre): a header row and one row per stat, columns of 'columns' widths: name, total, base, Lattice, gear. 'side' (right): the gear and the Lattice sections. Sections stack: header_height, then line_height lines, section_gap between sections; a wrapping line may take wrap_lines lines.
